item.title: [github_trending] tt-a1i/archify
item.description: Archify is a Node.js rendering and validation system for architecture diagrams, built for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode. Agents emit typed JSON IR, which Archify deterministically compiles into self-contained HTML/SVG, with five diagram types, four presets, dark/light themes, and a Before/Delta/After comparison for reviewing changes before merge. It suits developers who want to turn a codebase or system description into an interactive diagram inside an AI coding agent.

item.title: [infoq] 1周半写64个PR、完成30%项目重构：一家成熟SaaS公司把Agent塞进研发全流程后

In its IAM team, agents generated 64 PRs in one and a half weeks and completed about 30% of a large decoupling project. item.description: MQ Studio is an open-source message-queue client that began as rocket-leaf, the author's Wails3-based RocketMQ tool. After dissatisfaction with the official dashboard's resource usage and UI, the author rewrote the client, resetting the version from v0.1.3 to v0.0.1. It still only supports RocketMQ but is architecturally ready for Kafka, RabbitMQ and Pulsar; the author also open-sourced rocketmq-admin-go, a Golang admin library that interested the DBX project.

item.title: [infoq] Token消耗减少75%，千问办公创造了新的“省钱模式”
item.description: Alibaba Qwen released and open-sourced Qwen3.8-Flash on Aug 26, a multimodal MoE model with 125B main parameters and only 6B activated per token, priced at 0.8 yuan input / 2.7 yuan output per million tokens. The Qianwen Office standard mode built on it boosts single-task generation speed by about 100% and cuts average token consumption by 75%, covering roughly 95% of routine office tasks. The combination makes agent-assisted office work dramatically cheaper while keeping quality.

item.title: [infoq] 下一层抽象：从UX角度思考Agentic OS的样貌
item.description: This InfoQ opinion piece looks at Agentic OS from a UX perspective. GUIs already hide complexity, but they still force users to translate intent into software operations: a user sees a blurry video while the app offers codec, bitrate, and resolution settings. The author argues that power users mistake hard-won computer experience for common sense, and agent interfaces may be the next abstraction layer for expressing goals directly.

item.title: [infoq] 规模化 AI 代码审查：LinkedIn 的多智能体方案
item.description: LinkedIn built a multi-agent AI code review platform instead of bolting a generic tool onto GitHub. It combines independent reviewers using different models and reasoning methods, applies organization- and repo-specific rules, and filters noise. In an evaluation of 5,230 sampled comments across 1,727 PRs, 63.9% of suggestions were adopted; logic-error and concurrency fixes were accepted 80% and 100% of the time respectively.

item.title: [github_trending] every-app/open-seo
item.description: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs with a pay-as-you-go model: bring your own DataForSEO API key and no subscription required. It covers workflows like keyword research, rank tracking, backlinks and site audits, and exposes an MCP server so AI agents such as Claude Code can drive the tool. A good fit for developers and SEOs who want control without paying for a heavyweight suite.

item.title: [github_trending] tashfeenahmed/freellmapi
item.description: FreeLLMAPI, a trending GitHub project, aggregates 34 free LLM providers and 635 model endpoints behind a single OpenAI-compatible /v1 API, advertising 7.4 billion tokens per month. It handles smart routing, automatic failover on rate limits, encrypted key storage, and per-key usage tracking to keep you under each free-tier cap. Developers who want one endpoint for many free model APIs will find it useful; the project is MIT-licensed and ships a Docker image.

item.title: [github_trending] p-e-w/heretic
item.description: Heretic is a tool that automatically removes censorship (also called safety alignment) from transformer-based language models using directional ablation, a.k.a. abliteration, without expensive post-training. It should interest researchers and red-teamers who want a reproducible way to strip alignment and study how models behave after unalignment. Community channels include Discord, Matrix, and Hugging Face.

item.title: [juejin] 👉 尤雨溪再次成立新公司，同时官宣 Pinia 4 正式发布！
item.description: At the Vue conference, You Yuxi announced a new company, Vue Source Co., Ltd., set up to sponsor full-time open-source contributors working on Vue. He also unveiled the Pinia 4 major release, which now supports only ESM modules and shrinks the installed package size significantly. Vue developers should account for the ESM-only constraint.

item.title: [juejin] DeepSeek Harness 值得安装的 15 款插件
item.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) is gaining traction and its plugin ecosystem is expanding rapidly; this article highlights 15 plugins worth installing. Developers already using DSH and wanting to extend their workflow should find it a useful starting point.

item.title: [juejin] AI写长篇小说为什么30章必崩
item.description: This post explains why AI-authored novels typically fall apart around chapter 30, citing concrete failures like a protagonist's sister changing name and a chapter-5 setup never being resolved, then lays out an engineering-oriented fix. It's a useful reference for developers working on long-form LLM generation, agent memory, or context management.

item.title: [github_trending] Lakr233/vphone-cli
item.description: vphone-cli boots a virtual iPhone on Apple Silicon Macs using Apple's Virtualization.framework, built on the PCC research VM infrastructure. It requires Xcode and the iOS SDK, plus SIP/AMFI relaxation to obtain private entitlements, and one command creates a complete VM from end to end. Useful for iOS security research and automation without physical devices.

item.title: [github_trending] mvanhorn/last30days-skill
item.description: last30days-skill is an AI-agent skill that researches a topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket, and the web, then synthesizes a grounded summary. It's positioned as a search engine ranked by upvotes, likes, and real money rather than editors, and the README tracks the current v3 pipeline. Worth checking out for developers building research agents or working on AI-led search.

item.title: [github_trending] unclecode/crawl4ai
item.description: Crawl4AI is an open-source, LLM-friendly web crawler and scraper that gives model applications clean web data to consume, with a Python package on PyPI. Its Cloud API is now in closed beta and promises reliable large-scale web extraction. Developers who feed web content into LLM workflows or automation pipelines should take a look.

item.title: [github_trending] NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra
item.description: Ghidra is a software reverse-engineering framework created and maintained by NSA Research Directorate. It provides disassembly, decompilation, graphing, and scripting across Windows, macOS, and Linux, with broad support for instruction sets and executable formats. Built for scaling and teaming on complex SRE efforts, it can be extended via Java or Python — making it a go-to for malware analysis and security research.
